label: Front-end developer
bio: Front-end developer building responsive web interfaces for startups and small businesses. Comfortable turning a Figma file into production React.

label: Backend / API developer
bio: Backend engineer building APIs and database schemas. I work mostly in Node and Python and care about clean data models.

label: Mobile developer
bio: Mobile developer shipping cross-platform apps with Flutter. I have published several Android apps for local service businesses.

label: Data analyst
bio: Data analyst turning messy spreadsheets into dashboards and reports. I build models in Python and visualise results for non-technical teams.

label: Copywriter
bio: Copywriter producing website copy, blog articles and email campaigns. I write for fintech and retail brands across East Africa.

label: Translator / transcriber
bio: Translator working between English and Swahili. I transcribe interviews and localise marketing material for Kenyan audiences.

label: Graphic designer
bio: Graphic designer creating brand identities, logos and print material for small businesses and events.

label: Video editor
bio: Video editor cutting promotional clips, event recaps and social media reels. I also produce simple motion graphics.

label: Photographer
bio: Event and portrait photographer covering weddings, corporate functions and product shoots around the Rift Valley.

label: Social media marketer
bio: Social media manager running content calendars and paid campaigns on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook for consumer brands.

label: Virtual assistant
bio: Virtual assistant handling inboxes, scheduling, data entry and customer support for busy founders.

label: Bookkeeper
bio: Bookkeeper maintaining ledgers, reconciling accounts and preparing monthly management reports for SMEs.
